title: Monday
description: Monday Wudase Mariam praises the Incarnation of Christ, the restoration of Adam and Eve, the joy of Bethlehem, and asks for the intercession of Saint Mary.

title: Tuesday
description: Tuesday Wudase Mariam praises Saint Mary as the Virgin Mother of God, the ladder of Jacob, the burning bush, the treasure-house of Christ, and asks for her intercession on behalf of the faithful.

title: Wednesday
description: Wednesday Wudase Mariam praises Saint Mary as the second heaven, the eastern gate, the city of God, the true cloud, the ark, and the sealed door, while glorifying the Incarnation of the Word and her perpetual virginity.

title: Thursday
description: Thursday Wudase Mariam praises Saint Mary as the burning bush, celebrates the removal of Eve’s curse through her, recalls the angelic announcement and Christ’s birth, and proclaims the redemption brought by the Incarnate Word.

title: Friday
description: Friday Wudase Mariam praises Saint Mary as the Mother of Light, the spiritual city, the fountain of life, the dwelling-place of the Word, and the ladder to heaven, while celebrating the mystery of the Incarnation and the salvation brought through Christ.

title: Saturday
description: Saturday Wudase Mariam praises Saint Mary as full of grace, the second heaven, the holy tabernacle, Jacob’s ladder, and the intercessor of the faithful, while proclaiming the Incarnation of Christ and the salvation brought through Him.

title: Sunday
description: Sunday Wudase Mariam praises Saint Mary through many Old Testament images such as the Holy of Holies, the Ark, the sanctuary, the golden pot of manna, the golden lampstand, the golden censer, the flower from Jesse, and Aaron’s rod, while proclaiming Christ as the mediator of the New Covenant who became incarnate of her for our salvation.
